Hi Marissa and Mateo,

Thanks again for the quick intro call earlier - really excited about the potential fit between CloudBridge's marketplace program and Redwood Inference's dedicated/private offerings. From our side, the buyer use case that came up most is: CloudBridge customers wanting a managed inference option through the marketplace with strict network isolation and predictable latency.

To move this forward, our product and solutions engineering teams would like to run a partner-led discovery + technical deep dive with your SEs (to validate integration points and listing requirements).

High-level asks:
- Confirm Redwood contacts for the technical call (SE + PM)
- Propose 2-3 time slots next week for a 45-60m session

I can include Elena (our SE) on the thread - she can demo the marketplace side. Looking at our calendars, we have availability: Wed 5/26 9-11am PT, Thu 5/27 10-12pm PT, or Mon 5/31 1-3pm PT.

Thanks,
